name: Tashkent International Airport
notes: Secondary only. kun.uz, 7 Jan 2019 (read 18 Oct 2026): 'a 24-hour prayer room appeared at the International Airport named after Islam Karimov in Tashkent in November 2017'; a decree required 'ablution spaces for use and other facilities for praying by June 1, 2019' at international airports. islom.uz, 10 Sep 2019 (https://www.islom.uz/article/55, now 404; read via Wayback capture of 19 Sep 2019): 'The prayer room, which is still used by Muslim passengers, is located at the airport's international airport lobby B8.' Official sites tashkent-airport.uz / uzairports.uz returned 404 or no response. Unclear: which terminal today, side of security, wuḍūʾ actually provided, women's space. Not visually verified.

Not visually verified.
